description: Defines classes and structures for the implementation of a User-Plane message decoder in the Open Fronthaul protocol, including parameters, decoding methods, and dependencies on decompression and deserialization components.

classes.name: uplane_message_decoder_impl
classes.description: Implementation of the User-Plane message decoder with methods for decoding headers, sections, and IQ data, and handling decompression.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a User-Plane message from the input span.

methods.name: decode_all_sections
methods.description: Decodes all sections within the message.

methods.name: decode_section
methods.description: Decodes a single section and returns its status.

methods.name: decode_iq_data
methods.description: Decodes IQ data from the deserializer.
